notes_for_editor: The register is the only source for the tower's dates. It says the original location is unknown but also gives coordinates on the Great Plains, so the story names the area, not a spot. Left out on purpose: (1) the Vineyard Gazette report of the May 1916 island fire says it started in West Tisbury and its cause is unknown; no source ties it to the lookout. (2) The easternuslookouts.weebly.com Massachusetts page has a 1931 new 68-foot steel tower note that sits under the Great Meadow Hill (Rehoboth) entry, not Great Plain, by layout; the search snippet that linked it to Tisbury was wrong. (3) The 2022 Tisbury fire tower may be a town firefighting tower and not the lookout's remains. Searches found no staffing, fire or access record. Next checks: the Martha's Vineyard Museum archive and the Massachusetts State Forester reports for 1916 to 1944.
